decisions.reason: As an upgraded version of an already liked trommel screen in the firm’s core range, it likely meets aspiration levels and a mature machinery maker has enough slack to retain it.

The AK flail shredder line appears to have been refreshed rather than experimentally introduced, so continued mention after launch suggests satisfactory results relative to aspirations and low pressure to withdraw it.

The mobile high-speed grinder stayed and even gained its own page in 2019, which points to acceptable early performance, but weaker evidence and overlap with other grinder variants leave some moderate risk of later pruning.

Management publicly described the new CERON generation as setting standards and showed concrete application use, indicating performance above aspiration in a strategically important stationary shredding segment.
